You are responsible for preparing, cooking and presenting our dishes. You do this in support of, among others, the head chef and the sous-chef: you are part of a hardworking and friendly team. 
What do we offer you? - - 20% staff discount at over 20 affiliated hospitality establishments. - - A free gym membership at Gym Royale. - - Opportunity for personal and/or professional development. - - 25 holiday days per year with a full-time contract. - - A holiday allowance of 8% that is paid out annually and a well-arranged pension. 
What do we expect from you? - - Relevant work experience as an independent working chef. - - Quality-oriented, skilled and innovative. - - Stress-resistant with a hands-on mentality. - - Good command of Dutch and English. - - Knowledge of HACCP principles and Social Hygiene Diploma is an advantage. 
Will you come and strengthen our kitchen team? 
At Hannekes Boom you get the chance to work in a vibrant and energetic environment, where no day is the same. If you are ready to combine your passion for cooking with a good dose of cosiness, then we would like to get to know you.
